mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates a robust real economy expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 900 and GDPC1 > 11750.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220), the Federal Reserve initiates monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115) signals robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (PAYEMS > 137500), strong job growth fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 137500.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) indicate strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenues rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11750) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through higher corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 11750.
